title: thelypteris augescens var. puberula
intro: Thelypteris augescens var. puberula, commonly known as the pubescent maidenhair fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris augescens var. puberula include wound healing, fever reduction, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
